stemMarkdown: In a class, 22 boys have an average score of 54 and 23 girls have an average score of 47. What is the average score of the whole class? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total score $= 22 \times 54 + 23 \times 47 = 2269$ across $45$ students, so the average is $\dfrac{2269}{45} = 50.42$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The combined average must lie between 47 and 54, closer to whichever group is larger — a useful sanity check before computing.
